steps.prompt: Inspect this repository and summarize what it does, the main CLI commands a developer would use first, and any obvious operator-facing constraints. Do not modify files.

args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const workspaces=Array.isArray(pkg.workspaces)?pkg.workspaces:[]; const passed=pkg.name==='agentflow' && workspaces.includes('web-app'); console.log(JSON.stringify({passed, package_name: pkg.name, workspace_count: workspaces.length}, null, 2));
